CustomField.description: Heading for the new-record modal on Table sections, passed as new-record-modal-heading to c-flow-data-table. Applies only to Table component types when Enable New Action is checked (repeaters add rows inline, not via this modal).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Title for the popup that opens when a user adds a new row to a Table section. Applies to Tables only and requires Enable New Action.
CustomField.label: Modal Title
